new.ig:
Main breaker tripping when the ACs run together? ⚡ That's usually a sign your property needs a DEWA load increase.

Common triggers in Dubai:
✅ More AC units or a new kitchen
✅ Production machines or a server room
✅ An EV charger on a supply that's already near its limit

How it works: a DEWA-enrolled contractor surveys the site, prepares a revised load schedule and single line diagram, and applies to DEWA. DEWA's published target for LV design approval is 1 working day up to 150 kW.

We handle the survey, drawings, DEWA submission and the upgrade works. Details at megavolt.ae (link in bio).

📞 Call / WhatsApp +971 56 596 6254

#DEWA #LoadIncrease #PowerUpgrade #ElectricalContractor #Megavolt
new.li:
Breakers tripping every afternoon is rarely bad luck. In most Dubai properties it means the connected load has outgrown the approved load.

A DEWA load increase follows a clear path:
1. Site survey and load calculation
2. Revised MDB/SMDB load schedules and single line diagram
3. Online application by a DEWA-enrolled consultant or contractor
4. LV design approval (DEWA target: 1 working day up to 150 kW, 2 for 151–400 kW, 3 above 400 kW)
5. Connection cost invoice, upgrade works, LV inspection and supply release

Applying is free; DEWA charges a connection cost for the added load.

Full guide with documents and service times: https://www.uaeapprovalhub.com/guides/dewa-load-increase/

#DEWA #LoadIncrease #Dubai #ElectricalEngineering

new.li:
RTA eNOC in Dubai: one application, many authorities.

The eNOC system at noc.rta.ae routes a single NOC application to every affected authority, such as DEWA, Etisalat, du and Dubai Municipality. The final NOC is issued once all of them approve.

What catches applicants out:
• A submitted application cannot be edited, so the NOC type and project type must be right first time
• Requested hard copies are due within 10 calendar days
• Comments must be answered within 10 working days
• All approvals must be in within 60 working days, or the application is cancelled

Step-by-step eNOC guide: https://www.uaeapprovalhub.com/guides/rta-noc-dubai/
